You’ll work alongside our scientists and engineers on research, portfolio projects and technical diligence, and you’ll own a scoped project of your own. This is a software role. You won’t design hardware, but you’ll learn enough about the body to understand what it will and won’t let the brain do.

As the platform matures, this role will increasingly bridge mechanical and controls — running test-rig cycles, troubleshooting integration issues, and translating mechanical design changes into controls adjustments.  - Build and iterate on prototyping rigs — mechanical assembly, wiring, and basic controls integration
